text:
Preterm birth complications were the leading cause of death in children under five in 2017, at about 16% of under-5 deaths, narrowly ahead of pneumonia (lower respiratory infections) at about 15%. My earlier "roughly 1 million" figure was an approximation from memory, and the margin over pneumonia is small. I'm recalling these WHO/UN IGME shares from memory rather than checking a source now.
CONFIDENCE: 80
